lines.t: Hi! Can I get a cup of tea, please?
Sure. Would you like milk and sugar?
Milk, but no sugar, please.
Anything else?
Yes, one chicken sandwich.
That's two hundred and fifty taka.
Here you go. Thank you!

q.s: How does A want the tea?
What food does A order?
How much is it in total?

lines.t: Hello! Are you new here?
Yes, I moved in last week. I'm Rahim.
Nice to meet you, Rahim. I'm Sara. I live on the third floor.
Nice to meet you too. Do you work nearby?
Yes, I'm a teacher at the school across the road.
That's great. See you around!

q.s: When did Rahim move in?
Which floor does Sara live on?
What is Sara's job?

lines.t: Excuse me, how do I get to the bus station?
Go straight for about five minutes, then turn right.
Is it near the big mosque?
Yes, it's just opposite the mosque.
Thank you so much!
You're welcome.

q.s: How long should A go straight at first?
Which way should A turn after that?
Where is the bus station?

lines.t: Good morning, City Clinic. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to book an appointment with Doctor Hasan.
Sure. Is Thursday at four o'clock okay?
Sorry, I work until five on Thursday. Do you have anything on Saturday?
Yes, Saturday at eleven in the morning.
Perfect. My name is Rahim Ahmed.
Thank you, Mr. Ahmed. See you on Saturday.

q.s: Which doctor does A want to see?
Why can't A come on Thursday?
o: A will be out of Dhaka

q.s: When is the appointment in the end?

lines.t: Can I help you?
Yes, I'm looking for a blue shirt.
What size are you?
Medium, I think.
Here's one. It's on sale today, only eight hundred taka.
Can I try it on?
Of course. The changing room is over there.
It fits well. I'll take it.

q.s: What color shirt is A looking for?
How much is the shirt?
What does A do in the end?

lines.t: What are you doing this weekend?
I'm going to visit my grandparents in the village.
That sounds nice. How are you going there?
By train. It takes about four hours.
When are you coming back?
On Sunday evening. What about you?
I'm going to stay home and study for my exam.

q.s: Where is B going?
How is B travelling?
What will A do at the weekend?
o: Stay home and study for an exam

lines.t: Hello, Pizza Corner. What would you like?
I'd like one large chicken pizza, please.
Anything to drink?
Two bottles of water.
Okay. What's your address?
House twelve, Road five, Mirpur ten.
It will take about forty minutes.

q.s: What does A order?
Where does A live?
How long will the food take?

lines.t: Hello, I have a booking under the name Rahim.
Welcome, sir. Yes, a single room for two nights.
Is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant.
Great. What's the Wi-Fi password?
It's on your key card. Your room is three oh five, on the third floor.

q.s: How many nights is the booking for?
When is breakfast served?
What is the room number?

lines.t: So, tell me a little about yourself.
I'm a web developer with four years of experience. I mostly build websites for small businesses.
Why do you want to join our company?
I like your projects, and I want to work in a bigger team and learn new skills.
What is your biggest strength?
I'm good at solving problems, and I always try to finish my work on time.

q.s: How many years of experience does A have?

q.sbn: সে কেন এই কোম্পানিতে আসতে চায়?
obn: বড় দলে কাজ করে নতুন দক্ষতা শিখতে
q.s: Why does A want to join the company?
o: To work in a bigger team and learn new skills
Because the office is near home

obn: সমস্যার সমাধান আর সময়মতো কাজ শেষ করা
q.s: What is A's biggest strength?
o: Solving problems and finishing work on time

lines.t: Hi, thanks for joining. Can you hear me?
Yes, loud and clear. So, what do you need help with?
Our website is very slow, and we are losing customers.
I see. I can check the speed and send you a report by tomorrow.
That would be great. How much will it cost?
The report is free. If you want me to fix it, I'll send you a price after that.

q.s: What is the client's problem?
When will A send the report?
How much does the report cost?

lines.t: You're late again. Is everything okay?
I'm really sorry. There was a huge traffic jam because of an accident.
I understand, but the client meeting started at nine.
I know. Can I join now, or should I wait?
Join now. And next time, please send me a message if you're running late.
Of course. It won't happen again.

q.s: Why was A late?
o: A big traffic jam after an accident

q.s: What time did the client meeting start?

q.sbn: পরের বার কী করতে বলা হলো?
q.s: What should A do next time?
o: Send a message if running late

lines.t: Hi, I bought these headphones last week, but the left side doesn't work.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here it is.
Thank you. Would you like a new pair or your money back?
A new pair, please.
No problem. Let me check if we have them in stock.

q.s: What is wrong with the headphones?
What does the shop assistant ask for?
What does A want in the end?
